cpct_pen2twoPixelM0_table
cpct_pen2twoPixelM0_table:: .db 0x00, 0xC0, 0x0C, 0xCC, 0x030, 0xF0, 0x3C, 0xFC, 0x03, 0xC3, 0x0F, 0xCF, 0x33, 0xF3, 0x3F, 0xFF

Mode 0 PEN to 2-pixels-byte in screen mode format conversion table

This table associates the value of a Mode 0 PEN ([0-15]) with a byte encoding 2-mode-0-pixels all of the PEN colour associated. For instance, for PEN 1, it associates 0xC0, which means 2-mode-0-pixels of PEN 1.
